pages.text: Uraninite is Powah's reactor fuel and occurs in poor, normal, and dense ore variants.$(br2)Mine it with at least an iron-tier pickaxe. Fortune can improve the drops.
$(bold)1.12.2 worldgen defaults$()$(br)Poor: Y 0–64, 8 attempts, vein 5.$(br)Normal: Y 0–20, 6 attempts, vein 4.$(br)Dense: Y 1–8, 3 attempts, vein 3.
The dense band is adapted to the old 0–255 world height.
